source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of acyl chlorides (PDF 114).

blocks.text: Acyl chlorides ka functional group -COCl hai. Saturated aliphatic acyl chlorides ka aam formula CnH2n+1COCl hai aur IUPAC nizam mein inhein alkanoyl halides kehte hain, maslan ethanoyl chloride, CH3COCl, aur propanoyl chloride, CH3CH2COCl. Acyl chlorides carboxylic acids ke functional derivatives mein sab se zyada reactive hain, is liye aam taur par doosre derivatives, jaise esters aur amides, banane mein use hote hain.

blocks.prompt: CH3CH2COCl ka naam batayein aur woh reagent jo ise propanoic acid se banata hai.
blocks.explanation: Propanoyl chloride; SOCl2 (ya PCl5, ya PCl3 aur garmi).

items: Acyl chlorides: -COCl, naam alkanoyl chlorides; sab se reactive tezaab derivatives.
